about_the_game:
You want to shift to a new house. You think that every thing is fine with the house. But what if there is something wrong with the house. What if the house hides dark secretes. What if something happened in the house, that haunts the house. What might have gone wrong, What might have happened in the house. Is there any secret in the house that haunts the house. In order to find the answers, Basement is must play story driven, psychological horror experience.

Where you play as an young girl, who took a new job, in the new city, in the new town. Who took a house for rent for a change to live a peaceful and relaxed life.

Least did she know that not every thing is as it seemed to be. Soon you will discover that something is terribly wrong with the house. You feel as if someone or something is watching you, playing with you. You hear sounds as if the walls or floor is talking to you. You will soon find out that the house has a dark secrets about its previous owners.

You will have to find out what happened in the house in this mystery ,thriller, horror game.

You will play in a first person view. While exploring the entire house, and simultaneously knowing what happened in the house. If you are a horror fan, especially loves narrative and story driven experience, basement is a must play game. And find out what happened in the house, while encountering the horror elements, in this scary, psychological horror game.

name: Basement

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: 4 core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 4 GB VRAM; Radeon RX 470, GeForce GTX 970
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 bit
  • Processor: 6 or 8 core CPU
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: A young girl took a new job, and took a new house for rent in a new city. Only to find out that the house hides dark secrets in it. Find out what happened in the house in this Psychological, narrative horror experience.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Turkish, Russian
*languages with full audio support
